name: scout-content-studio
description: Scout Content Studio static site (Spectral template by HTML5 UP)

scripts.build:css: cd assets/css && cleancss --inline none -o main.min.css main.css && cleancss --inline none -o custom.min.css custom.css && cleancss --inline none -o motion.min.css motion.css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/util.js -c -m -o assets/js/util.min.js && terser assets/js/main.js -c -m -o assets/js/main.min.js && terser assets/js/motion.js -c -m -o assets/js/motion.min.js && terser assets/js/before-after.js -c -m -o assets/js/before-after.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
